# Repository instructions

This file is retained as a compatibility pointer for existing links.

The canonical repository-wide instructions are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). GitHub Copilot instructions are in [`.github/copilot-instructions.md`](copilot-instructions.md).

All agents must follow the shared rules in `.ai/rules/` and choose the smallest suitable workflow from `.ai/workflows/`. Do not assume every task requires a full PRD or architecture document.
